scripts.speaker: Airship Staff
scripts.text:
Welcome! Would you like
to board the Airship that
departs on the flight which stops
in Juno and Rachel?

scripts.speaker: Airship Staff
scripts.text:
The boarding fee is
1,200 zeny. However, this
charged is waived if you use
a Free Ticket for Airship. Now,
would you still like to board?

scripts.speaker: Airship Staff
scripts.text:
I'm sorry, but you don't
have 1,200 zeny to pay
for the boarding fee.

scripts.speaker: Airship Staff
scripts.text:
Thank you and
please come again.
Have a good day~
